781.aj: 〒401-0502 山梨県南都留郡山中湖村平野４７９−２ 水辺のボードウォーク

rv.t: This is my 1st time to visit here, make me feel surprised, i think here is the most beautiful view of Big Mt. Fuji, like a panorama view and quiet atmosphere, Clear weather in December (2022) there are a few tourists to visit here. It is not far from Kawaguchiko Lake. There is a park like a playgroud and bike lane.

A big, scenic park that isn’t quite known by tourists, so it doesn’t get so crowded. There are mostly locals coming to this place. It’s more like a sports prk with running and cycling trails. But the wooden walking trail on the side makes rhis place such a lovely spot to sit, stroll and enjoy the view in quietude. It’s best visited during sunset where the sun shines on the lake with the glorious view of Fuji-san.
Beautiful walk and bike ride

是非一度お立ち寄りください！7月の三連休の日曜日、誰もいなくて一人占めしました。キレイな更衣室、トイレ、シャワー完備です。飲み物は必ず持参することをおすすめします。

783.a: Japan, 〒894-0412 Kagoshima, Oshima District, Tatsugo, Ashitoku, 339-2 CAFE 安処

783.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and hearty breakfast sets, especially the avocado toast and warm egg sandwich, which feature fresh ingredients. They also highlight the peaceful, charming, and cozy atmosphere, often described as having a jungle or forest vibe. Guests mention the friendly and attentive staff, who provide excellent service.
783.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、新鮮な食材を使ったボリューム満点の美味しい朝食セット、特にアボカドトーストと温かい卵サンドが高く評価されています。また、ジャングルや森のような雰囲気と表現される、穏やかで魅力的、かつ居心地の良い空間も特徴です。親切で気配りの行き届いたスタッフによる素晴らしいサービスも、高く評価されています。

rv.t: This is such a charming little café surrounded by nature. The peaceful setting makes it the perfect place to relax and enjoy a meal. The food was made fresh and was absolutely delicious. You can really taste the quality and care that goes into each dish. The atmosphere is warm, cozy, and welcoming, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. My only downside was that there wasn't a non-dairy milk option for…

Hidden gem with a jungle/forest vibe and absolutely delicious breakfast sets. They somehow manage to elevate a simple avo toast to another level. Super chilled out space, lovely owners, great understated service and tasty food-perfect!

What a surprise this place was. As soon as you walk in, you get strong Chiang Mai jungle-cafe vibes. There are pomelo trees around, and the whole atmosphere feels peaceful and a bit tropical. The shop is run by a very lovely older lady, which makes everything feel even more charming. Since we arrived before 11:00, we ordered the very affordable breakfast set. Unfortunately the egg sandwich was already sold out, but…

784.a: Cape Kasarizaki Lighthouse, 881 Kasaricho Oaza Yo, Amami, Kagoshima 894-0621, Japan
784.aj: 〒894-0621 鹿児島県奄美市笠利町大字用８８１ 笠利崎灯台
784.ed: Visitors say this lighthouse offers stunning panoramic views of the East China Sea and the Pacific Ocean, with many highlighting the beautiful sunsets. They also mention the short, manageable climb to the lighthouse, taking around 5 to 10 minutes. Others appreciate the convenient parking options nearby, including a larger lot with restrooms.
784.edj: この灯台を訪れた人は、東シナ海と太平洋の素晴らしいパノラマビューを高く評価しており、特に美しい夕焼けを挙げるクチコミが多くあります。また、灯台までの道のりは5分から10分程度で、短く無理なく登れるという声もあります。近くにはトイレ付きの広い駐車場を含む便利な駐車スペースがあることも好評のようです。

rv.t: The lighthouse is located at the northern most point of the island and is subsequently very exposed. We visited on a day when the weather was very changeable and ended up climbing the path in strong winds and intermittent light rain. The views were amazing, especially with the weather making everything that much more dramatic! I’m sure the views are equally wonderful when there is sunshine and blue sky! Definitely…
Very nice view, great shape for its age.
magnificent! feel the strength of nature. January 2023 & May 2026

785.a: Tomori Beach, 2127-1 Kasaricho Oaza Ushuku, Amami, Kagoshima 894-0501, Japan
785.aj: 〒894-0501 鹿児島県奄美市笠利町大字宇宿２１２７−１ 土盛海岸
785.ed: Visitors say this beach features stunningly clear, blue water and white sand, making it ideal for swimming and snorkeling with diverse fish and sea turtles. They also highlight the peaceful, uncrowded atmosphere and convenient parking, with some mentioning a nearby water tap for rinsing sand.
785.edj: このビーチを訪れた人は、驚くほど澄んだ青い海と白い砂浜が特徴だと評価しています。そのため、さまざまな魚やウミガメと一緒に泳いだり、シュノーケリングをしたりするのに理想的というクチコミが多くあります。また、静かで混雑していない雰囲気や、便利な駐車場も高く評価されています。中には、砂を洗い流すための水道が近くにあることに言及する人もいます。

rv.t: A truly beautiful beach with crystal-clear water, soft sand, and a peaceful atmosphere. It's well worth the visit if you're exploring Amami. The beach is about a 5-minute walk from a somewhat vague parking area. There's a walking trail by the beach that is paved. One thing to be aware of is the restroom situation. I didn't see any modern bathroom facilities only 2 older, very dark Japanese-style toilet with door a…

Beautiful beach, not many people. Snorkeling is good, not many corals, but different fish swim. Lots of parrot fish. The beach is beautiful and not crowded, which is a big plus. The water is clear, and snorkeling is a great way to see what's underwater. While there aren't a lot of corals, you'll see many different kinds of fish swimming around, especially many parrot fish. They are very colorful and easy to spot.

A great beach less than 10 mins from the airport. It has clean sand; a toilet; and a free parking area. Beware of the rip-tide ( the warning is posted in Japanese) and also double check before using the toilet as the Habu Viper likes to lurk in wait!

786.a: La Fonte, 1325-3 Akaogi, Tatsugo, Oshima District, Kagoshima 894-0411, Japan
786.aj: 〒894-0411 鹿児島県大島郡龍郷町赤尾木１３２５−３ La Fonte ラフォンテ
786.ed: People say this gelateria offers delicious, handmade gelato with unique local flavors like Amami brown sugar and true salt, alongside seasonal fruit options. 786.edj: このジェラート店を訪れた人は、奄美黒糖や真塩（ましゅ）といった奄美ならではの珍しい味や、季節のフルーツを使った手作りジェラートが美味しいと評価しています。店内は洗練されたおしゃれな雰囲気で、屋内外に席があり、リラックスして過ごせるという声が多くあります。スタッフは親しみやすく、丁寧な対応で、駐車場も利用しやすいと好評です。

rv.t: Tasty gelato in a cute shop, perfect for a break while riding your bike around the island. Salt, passion fruit and their local brown sugar are the standouts. Friendly, welcoming service too
Delicious and refreshing gelato, smooth texture. Price is a bit high but super delicious. Fast service, waiting time less than 5-10 minutes. Outside and inside seats. Will come back for all flavors.

Popular roadside gelato shop with outdoor and indoor seating. Offering unusual flavors such as pomelo, brown sugar and chai. There are three cup sizes: single, double (500 yen) and triple. Friendly service.

787.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious Keihan, especially its flavorful chicken broth, and appreciate that both rice and soup are refillable. Guests mention the spacious dining area and ample parking, making it convenient for families and groups.
787.edj: このレストランの鶏飯は、美味しくて風味豊かな鶏だしが特徴で、ご飯とスープがおかわり自由というクチコミが多くあります。新鮮で美味しい鶏刺しや、広々として清潔な店内も高く評価されています。

rv.t: Spacious restaurant, fast service. No waiting time when I was there. Family and group friendly. Affordable pricing. Super delicious and tasty Keihan, the chicken broth is overwhelmingly refreshing, clear and tasty. Hope to come back soon.
My snorkeling instructor recommended it for lunch and it was very good. I got to try a local dish and that's always fun. They were really nice and the food was delicious.
It is a good place to try traditional Keihan meals from Amami. The service is good and it is consistent, fast. It is also conveniently located on the side of the highway.

788.ed: People say this tourist destination offers breathtaking views of the ocean and cape, making the walk well worth the effort. They also mention the opportunity to see unique plants and butterflies along the trail.
788.edj: この観光地を訪れた人からは、海と岬の息をのむような景色が広がり、歩く価値が十分にあるという声が多くあります。道のりの大半はきれいに整備されており、入り口で杖を借りられる点も好評です。また、道中では珍しい植物や蝶を見ることができるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: We went here the morning of our departure from Amami, enjoyed a pleasant walk through the forest before arriving at a beautiful grassy cape. The path was well maintained (there was a maintenance worker mowing the grass beside the path when we were there), and there was a biotoilet at the cape. There seemed to be rabbit droppings at some points on the path, so if you're lucky you may get to spot one. The barriers at…

For me personally the view wasn't worth trekking through muggy 27 C weather, but I am not built for hot weather anyway. About 70% of the path is shaded and it gets very windy once you get to the cape, which helped.

A fantastic cape walk, the best cape to explore in Amami on a good day! Near to the end of the cape, there are two divulging paths where both are worth to explore, one goes to the tip whole the other goes to the side where you can even walk down to the rocks. Do be careful as the tides are strong in this area. Grasses can be pretty overgrown and seems like it's a popular spot with the Amami rabbits as we spotted…

789.edj: この観光地を訪れた人は、そびえ立つ崖や岩の造形が織りなすダイナミックな景色と、美しい周辺の海を高く評価しています。また、駐車場が利用しやすいため、展望台まで簡単にアクセスできる点も特徴として挙げられています。

rv.t: Nice platform built to observe the cliffs. Some explanation was made on how hard the rock is and how difficult it was to drill the road tunnel where you can see from this platform. A quick rest stop for some photos! It was also fascinating to observe the cycads growing on these rocks in rather extreme conditions when raining or windy.

Surprisingly, it sugar crsipy bread get along really well with the soft serve.

The night view was also very nice. One of the best moment I spent here during 5 nights and 6 days in Cebu.

Amazing views of the city of Cebu. No need to book a taxi to get up here simply take public transportation from the IT park! Beautiful at sunset and there’s also a lot of restaurants to eat up there as well.

五島福江島の東、福江港から船で30分ほどのところに位置する島です。港から北東の漁港まで歩いても15分程度とかなり小さい部類です。 南の黄島と同様、猫が多数放し飼いされています。住人がかなり少ないこともあってか、ふんの掃除など手入れが追い付いてないところもあるので、道を歩く際はお気をつけください。一方イノシシについては2023年11月時点では生息していないとの話です。 眺望スポットは、岩盤が露出した南の海岸です。山道を歩きますが、起伏は少なく一応舗装もされています。神社から歩いても15分かからないくらいです。 その他注意点として、島内に公衆トイレはありません。事前に福江か黄島で済ませるか、船のトイレを利用してください。
